 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Round 4 matches. 
 November 20, 2026 16:51 
 4:30 PM matches today
 Vidarbha takes on Mumbai
 Himachal Pradesh faces Pondicherry
 Railways vs Haryana
 Rajasthan takes on Baroda
 November 20, 2026 16:39 
 Results so far
 Kerala beats Tripura by 5 wickets
Sikkim beats Manipur by 9 runs
Chhattisgarh vs Gujarat abandoned
Uttarakhand vs Odisha abandoned
Andhra beats Madhya Pradesh by 70 runs
Jharkhand beats Karnataka by 7 wickets
J&K beats Bihar by 9 runs
Punjab beats Tamil Nadu by 5 runs
UP beats Chandigarh by 30 runs
Maharashtra beats Assam by 5 wickets
Services beats Nagaland by 6 wickets
Hyderabad vs Goa abandoned
Meghalaya beats Arunachal Pradesh by 35 runs
Bengal beats Mizoram by 93 runs
Saurashtra beats Delhi by 5 wickets
 November 20, 2026 15:46 
 Kerala vs Tripura
 A comfortable win for Kerala over Tripura. Chases down a paltry 122-run target with seven overs remaining and five wickets in hand. 
 November 20, 2026 15:36 
 Bengal vs Mizoram
 A strong batting performance takes Bengal 196 for two in the first innings. Abishek Porel and Karan Lal score fifties. 
 November 20, 2026 14:53 
 Madhya Pradesh vs Andhra
 A forgettable performance by Madhya Pradesh. Andhra defeats MP by 70 runs, bowling the Central Zone team out for mere 116 runs while defending 186. 
 November 20, 2026 14:45 
 Karnataka vs Jharkhand
 Anukul Roy and Virat Singh score fifties to help Jharkhand beat Karnataka by seven wickets, comfortably chasing down a 175-run target. 
 November 20, 2026 14:07 
 Update at 2:00 PM!
 Jharkhand 88/3 (11) while chasing 175 vs Karnataka
 Madhya Pradesh 102/8 (16) while chasing 187 vs Andhra
 Bihar 143/4 (15.2) while chasing 191 vs J&K
 Manipur sets target of 143 for Sikkim
 Tripura 59/5 (11) vs Kerala
 Bengal 18/0 (2) vs Mizoram
 Delhi 61/1 (6) vs Saurashtra
 Uttarakhand vs Odisha match abandoned without a ball bowled
 Chhattisgarh vs Gujarat match abandoned without a ball bowled 
 November 20, 2026 13:24 
 Positive news for Uttar Pradesh!
 SMAT 2026: Kuldeep Yadav to feature in Uttar Pradesh’s last three league games
 Uttar Pradesh will have a timely boost for the business end of its Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy campaign, with Kuldeep Yadav set to join the squad for its final three fixtures.
 November 20, 2026 13:11 
 Update at 1:00 PM
 Jharkhand 9/0 (1) while chasing 175 vs Karnataka
 Madhya Pradesh 20/1 (1) while chasing 187 vs Andhra
 Bihar 21/0 (1.2) while chasing 191 vs J&K
 Manipur has elected to bat against Sikkim
 Tripura has elected to bat against Kerala
 November 20, 2026 12:36 
 Update at 12:30 PM
 Kartik Chada picks up three as Punjab beats Tamil Nadu by five runs.
 Chandigarh failed to chase down UP’s 191-run target and lost by 30 runs in their clash, while Meghalaya beat Arunachal Pradesh by 35 runs.
 Elsewhere, Manish Pandey is trying to rescue Karnataka’s innings as it loses five wickets against Jharkhand, with 151 on the board after 17.4 overs.
 November 20, 2026 12:03 
 Update at 12:00 PM
 Tamil Nadu is in a spot of bother in its chase of 165 against Punjab, having lost six wickets, while Maharashtra, led by captain Ruturaj Gaikwad defeated Assam by four wickets.
 Elsewhere, Karnataka is reeling at 94/4 against defending champion Jharkhand, while Jammu and Kashmir is 120/4 batting first against Bihar.
 November 20, 2026 10:41 
 Latest update!
 Hyderabad vs Goa - Match abandoned without a ball bowled
 Services 57/3 (9) while chasing 135 vs Nagaland
 Arunachal Pradesh 66/4 (9) while chasing 180 vs Meghalaya
 Maharashtra 9/1 (1) while chasing 173 vs Assam
 UP 190/7 (20) vs Chandigarh
 November 20, 2026 09:47 
 Punjab stuttering against Tamil Nadu!
 Manimaran Siddharth has spun a web around the Punjab batters, the Northern heavyweights are 59/3 after eight overs, with Anmolpreet Singh and Ramandeep Singh at the crease. In-form batters Uday Saharan and Salil Arora are already back in the dugout.
 November 20, 2026 09:23 
 The scores so far!
 A few matches have already begun. Here are the scores:
 Nagaland 83/5 vs Services
 Meghalaya 133/2 vs Arunachal Pradesh
 Assam 61/2 vs Maharashtra
 Uttar Pradesh 27/0 vs Chandigarh
 Punjab 21/3 vs Tamil Nadu

 Stay with us for all of the live updates from today.
